sum(fixed.values())\\n        base = sum(w[s] for s in free) or 1.0\\n        nw = {s: fixed.get(s, rem * w[s] / base) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n        if max(abs(nw[s] - w[s]) for s in UNIVERSE) < 1e-10:\\n            w = nw\\n            break\\n        w = nw\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: float(w[s] / z) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _last_decision\\n    selected = _ensemble()\\n    if not selected:\\n        return\\n    factor_ids = [x[\\"factor_id\\"] for x in selected]\\n    fw = {x[\\"factor_id\\"]: float(x[\\"weight\\"]) for x in selected}\\n    fd = {x[\\"factor_id\\"]: float(x.get(\\"direction\\", 1)) for x in selected}\\n    data = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=120)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 70:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        c = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        r = c[1:] / np.maximum(c[:-1], 1e-12) - 1.0\\n        data[s] = (c, r, str(df.iloc[-1][\\"date\\"]))\\n    if len(data) < 12:\\n        return\\n    decision_date = max(v[2] for v in data.values())\\n    if _last_decision is not None:\\n        try:\\n            if (np.datetime64(decision_date) - np.datetime64(_last_decision)) / np.timedelta64(1, \\"D\\") < REBALANCE_DAYS:\\n                return\\n        except Exception:\\n            return\\n\\n    vol, r20, r60, skew, volmom = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}\\n    for s, (c, r, _) in data.items():\\n        vol[s] = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.008)\\n        r20[s] = float(c[-1] / max(c[-21], 1e-12) - 1.0)\\n        r60[s] = float(c[-1] / max(c[-61], 1e-12) - 1.0)\\n        skew[s] = float(np.mean(((r[-20:] - np.mean(r[-20:])) / vol[s]) ** 3))\\n        volmom[s] = r20[s] / vol[s]\\n    dispersion = max(float(np.std(list(r20.values()))), 0.01)\\n    signals = {f: {} for f in factor_ids}\\n    for s in data:\\n        vals = {\\n            \\"miner_1_low_volatility_20d\\": -vol[s],\\n            \\"miner_3_vol_scaled_relative_contrarian_20d\\": -r20[s] / vol[s],\\n            \\"miner_2_trend_acceleration_20_60\\": r20[s] - MIN_WEIGHT * len(low) - MAX_WEIGHT * len(high)\\n        scale = rem / max(sum(w[s] for s in free), 1e-12)\\n        w = {s: MIN_WEIGHT if s in low else MAX_WEIGHT if s in high else w[s] * scale for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / z for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _last_decision\\n    specs = load_ensemble()\\n    if not specs:\\n        return\\n\\n    series = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=170)\\n        if df is not None and len(df) >= 80:\\n            df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\")\\n            series[s] = (np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], float), np.asarray(df[\\"open\\"], float), str(df.iloc[-1][\\"date\\"]))\\n    if len(series) < 12:\\n        return\\n    decision_date = max(v[2] for v in series.values())\\n    if _last_decision is not None:\\n        try:\\n            if (np.datetime64(decision_date) - np.datetime64(_last_decision)) / np.timedelta64(1, \\"D\\") < 10:\\n                return\\n        except Exception:\\n            return\\n\\n    vals = {f: {} for f in specs}\\n    vols, r20s = {}, {}\\n    for s, (c, o, _) in series.items():\\n        ret = c[1:] / np.maximum(c[:-1], 1e-12) - 1.0\\n        vol = max(float(np.std(ret[-20:])), 0.008)\\n        vols[s] = vol\\n        r10 = c[-1] / max(c[-11], 1e-12) - 1.0\\n        r20 = c[-1] / max(c[-21], 1e-12) - 1.0\\n        r60 = c[-1] / max(c[-61], 1e-12) - 1.0\\n        r20s[s] = r20\\n        accel10 = (r10 - r20 / 2.0) / vol\\n        accel20 = (r20 - r60 / 3.0) / vol\\n        recovery = (c[-1] / max(np.min(c[-61:-1]), 1e-12) - 1.0) / (1.0 + vol)\\n        neg20 = ret[-20:][ret[-20:] < 0]\\n        neg10 = ret[-10:][ret[-10:] < 0]\\n        down20 = float(np.std(neg20)) if len(neg20) > 1 else vol\\n        down10 = float(np.std(neg10)) if len(neg10) > 1 else vol\\n        vals[\\"vol_adjusted_trend_acceleration_10d\\"][s] = accel10\\n        vals[\\"trend_acceleration_volscaled_20d\\"][s] = accel20\\n        vals[\\"miner_2_trend_acceleration_20_60\\"][s] = r20 - r60 / 3.0\\n        vals[\\"miner_3_drawdown_recovery_20d\\"][s] = recovery\\n        vals[\\"miner_1_low_volatility_20d\\"][s] = -vol\\n        vals[\\"miner_2_20280810_downside_vol_reversal_20d\\"][s] = -r20 * (0.5 + down20 / vol)\\n        vals[\\"miner_3_vol_scaled_relative_contrarian_20d\\"][s] = r20 / vol\\n        vals[\\"miner_2_20280824_downside_vol_reversal_10d\\"][s] = -r10 * (0.5 + down10 / vol)\\n\\n    ranks = {f: cross_rank(vals[f]) for f in specs}\\n    score = {s: sum(x[\\"weight\\"] * x[\\"direction\\"] * ranks[f][s] for f, x in specs.items()) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    breadth = float(np.mean([r20s[s] > 0 for s in series]))\\n    bearish = r20s.get(\\"SPX\\", 0.0) < 0 and breadth < 0.55\\n    if bearish:\\n        for s in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"):\\n            score[s] += 0.10\\n        for s in (\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\"):\\n            score[s] -= 0.06\\n\\n    avgvol = float(np.mean(list(vols.values())))\\n    raw = {s: max(score[s], 0.01) * (0.85 + 0.15 * avgvol / vols.get(s, avgvol)) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    weights = simplex(raw)\\n    mean, sd = float(np.mean(list(score.values()))), max(float(np.std(list(score.values()))), 1e-9)\\n    forecast = {s: float(0.008 * (score[s] - mean) / sd) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    rebalance_to_weights(weights, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=list(specs), horizon_days=10)\\n    _last_decision = decision_date\\n"}', call_id='call_p2B2hZ3yBbN5VsjywEP3zrTP', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_tmp_mif6qn20hc', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

sum(fixed.values())\\n        scale = remain / max(sum(w[s] for s in free), 1e-12)\\n        changed = False\\n        for s in free:\\n            x = w[s] * scale\\n            if x < MIN_WEIGHT:\\n                fixed[s] = MIN_WEIGHT; changed = True\\n            elif x > MAX_WEIGHT:\\n                fixed[s] = MAX_WEIGHT; changed = True\\n        if not changed:\\n            for s in free:\\n                w[s] = w[s] * scale\\n            break\\n    w.update(fixed)\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: float(w[s] / z) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _last_decision\\n    factors = ensemble()\\n    if not factors:\\n        return\\n    ids = {f[\\"factor_id\\"] for f in factors}\\n    vals = {fid: {} for fid in ids}\\n    vol, trend, residual = {}, {}, {}\\n    dates = []\\n    closes = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=190)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 85:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\")\\n        c = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        if len(c) < 65 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):\\n            continue\\n        closes[s] = c\\n        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - a20/2) / v20,\\n            \\"miner_2_trend_acceleration_20_60\\": (a20 - a60/3) / v60,\\n            \\"miner_3_drawdown_recovery_20d\\": (c[-1]/max(np.min(c[-61:-1]), 1e-12)-1) / (1+v20),\\n            \\"miner_1_low_volatility_20d\\": -v20,\\n            \\"miner_3_consistency_momentum_10d\\": np.mean(r[-10:] > 0)-.5 + a10/(2*v20),\\n            \\"miner_3_downside_risk_momentum_10d\\": a10/downside,\\n            \\"miner_3_trend_curvature_10d\\": (a10 - a10) / v20\\n    date_key = str(max(dates))\\n    if _last_decision is not None:\\n        try:\\n            if (np.datetime64(date_key)-np.datetime64(_last_decision))/np.timedelta64(1, \\"D\\") < 10:\\n                return\\n        except Exception:\\n            return\\n    ranks = {fid: cs_rank(v) for fid, v in vals.items()}\\n    score = {s: sum(float(f[\\"weight\\"])*int(f.get(\\"direction\\", 1))*ranks[f[\\"factor_id\\"]][s] for f in factors) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    breadth = float(np.mean([trend[s] > 0 for s in trend]))\\n    if trend.get(\\"SPX\\", 0) < 0 or breadth < .40:\\n        for s in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"):\\n            score[s] += .10\\n        for s in (\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\"):\\n            score[s] -= .05\\n    avg_vol = max(float(np.mean(list(vol.values()))), .008)\\n    raw = {s: max(score[s], .01) * (.85 + .15*avg_vol/max(vol[s], .008)) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    weights = bounded(raw)\\n    mean, sd = float(np.mean(list(score.values()))), max(float(np.std(list(score.values()))), 1e-9)\\n    forecast = {s: float(.008*(score[s]-mean)/sd) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    rebalance_to_weights(weights, forecast_returns=forecast,\\n                         factor_ids=[f[\\"factor_id\\"] for f in factors], horizon_days=10)\\n    _last_decision = date_key\\n"}', call_id='call_iV6K1kchlLy2dldJVylrZSZb', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_tmp_2tdvgwm0m4p', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

sum(w[s] for s in fixed)\\n        if not free or rem <= 0: break\\n        z = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        for s in free: w[s] *= rem / z\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: float(w[s] / z) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _last_decision\\n    factors = load_factors()\\n    if not factors:\\n        return\\n    ids = [str(f[\\"factor_id\\"]) for f in factors]\\n    panels = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=230)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 70:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\")\\n        c = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        if len(c) < 65 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c)) or np.any(c <= 0):\\n            continue\\n        panels[s] = c\\n    if len(panels) < 12:\\n        return\\n\\n    # Use the common trailing date. All values are therefore observable at the\\n    # decision and the one-day lag is represented by using bars ending at -2.\\n    end = min(len(c) for c in panels.values()) - 2\\n    if end < 64:\\n        return\\n    returns = {s: panels[s][1:end+2] / panels[s][:end+1] - 1.0 for s in panels}\\n    r20 = {s: panels[s][end] / panels[s][end-20] - 1.0 for s in panels}\\n    median20 = float(np.median(list(r20.values())))\\n    vol20 = {s: max(float(np.std(returns[s][end-20:end])), 0.008) for s in panels}\\n\\n    raw = {fid: {} for fid in ids}\\n    breadth = []\\n    # Cross-sectional positive-return breadth used by the reversal factor.\\n    for k in (end-2, end-1, end):\\n        breadth.append(float(np.mean([panels[s][k] / panels[s][k-20] - 1.0 > 0 for s in panels])))\\n    for s, c in panels.items():\\n        rr = returns[s]\\n        neg = np.minimum(rr, 0.0)\\n        down40 = max(float(np.std(neg[end-40:end])), 0.008)\\n        # smoothed, lagged 20-day downside-vol reversal\\n        rev_hist = []\\n        for k in (end-4, end-3, end-2):\\n            if k < 40: continue\\n            x = c[k] / c[k-20] - 1.0\\n            b = float(np.mean([panels[t][k] / panels[t][k-20] - 1.0 > 0 for t in panels]))\\n            dn = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(returns[s][k-40:k], 0.0))), 0.008)\\n            rev_hist.append((-x / dn) * (abs(b - 1 > 0 for s in panels])\\n    high_risk = breadth10 < 0.55 or panels[\\"SPX\\"][end] / panels[\\"SPX\\"][end-10] - 1 < 0\\n    if high_risk:\\n        for s in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"): scores[s] += 0.15\\n        for s in (\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\"): scores[s] -= 0.08\\n    mean, sd = np.mean(list(scores.values())), max(np.std(list(scores.values())), 1e-9)\\n    forecast = {s: float(0.008 * (scores[s] - import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Must mirror the Screener ensemble exactly.
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.30, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.25, 1),
    ("miner_1_20300418_downside_reversal_conditioned_10d", 0.15, 1),
    ("miner_3_20300530_efficiency_shock_reversal_10d", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_2_20300530_relative_downside_reversal_10d", 0.10, 1),
    ("miner_2_20300124_lowvolatility_10d", 0.08, 1),
]
last_decision = -10**9

def percentile(values):
    finite = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(finite)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(n, 1)
    return out

def bounded_weights(score):
    # Diversified full investment; defensive posture is expressed through assets.
    lo, hi = 0.02, 0.15
    raw = {s: max(float(score.get(s, 0.5)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE}
    w = {s: raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in UNIVERSE}
    for _ in range(40):
        fixed = {s: (lo if w[s] < lo else hi) for s in UNIVERSE if w[s] < lo or w[s] > hi}
        if not fixed: break
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]
        rem = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())
        z = sum(raw[s] for s in free)
        w = dict(fixed)
        for s in free: w[s] = rem * raw[s] / max(z, 1e-12)
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: float(w[s] / z) for s in UNIVERSE}

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global last_decision
    closes = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 130: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        if len(c) >= 130 and np.all(np.isfinite(c)) and np.all(c > 0): closes[s] = c
    if len(closes) < 10: return
    end = min(len(c) for c in closes.values()) - 2  # only completed data, with one-day lag
    if end < 100 or end - last_decision < 10: return
    vals = {fid: {} for fid, _, _ in ENSEMBLE}
    # Price-only implementations of the admitted, close-based factor definitions.
    for s, c in closes.items():
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        r10, r20 = r[end-10:end], r[end-20:end]
        v10, v20 = max(np.std(r10), .008), max(np.std(r20), .008)
        hist = [np.std(r[k-20:k]) for k in range(max(20, end-80), end)]
        baseline = max(float(np.median(hist)), .008)
        ret10 = c[end] / c[end-10] - 1.0
        path = max(float(np.sum(np.abs(r10))), 1e-8)
        d = r20[r20 < 0]
        dvol = max(float(np.std(d)) if len(d) > 1 else v20, .008)
        downshare = float(np.mean(r20 < 0))
        # Compression and defensive-quality favor stable, orderly assets.
        vals[ENSEMBLE[0][0]][s] = -(v20 / baseline) - .25 * max(v10 / v20 - 1, 0)
        vals[ENSEMBLE[1][0]][s] = -v20 - .25 * max(v20 - baseline, 0)
        vals[ENSEMBLE[2][0]][s] = (-ret10 / dvol) if c[end] / c[end-60] - 1 > -.15 else 0.0
        efficiency = abs(ret10) / path
        vals[ENSEMBLE[3][0]][s] = -ret10 / v20 * (1 - min(efficiency, 1))
        med10 = np.median([closes[x][end] / closes[x][end-10] - 1 for x in closes])
        vals[ENSEMBLE[4][0]][s] = -(ret10 - med10) / dvol
        vals[ENSEMBLE[5][0]][s] = -v20
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for fid, wt, direction in ENSEMBLE:
        rr = percentile(vals[fid])
        for s in UNIVERSE: score[s] += wt * direction * rr[s]
    # Bullish but medium risk: retain breadth, with a modest defensive tilt.
    breadth = np.mean([closes[s][end] > closes[s][end-60] for s in closes])
    if breadth < .55:
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"): score[s] += .10
    score = {s: score[s] - min(score.values()) + .05 for s in UNIVERSE}
    target = bounded_weights(score)
    avg, sd = np.mean(list(score.values())), max(np.std(list(score.values())), 1e-8)
    forecast = {s: float(.006 * (score[s] - avg) / sd) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=[x[0] for x in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    last_decision = end

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Must mirror the Screener ensemble exactly.
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.30, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.25, 1),
    ("miner_1_20300418_downside_reversal_conditioned_10d", 0.15, 1),
    ("miner_3_20300530_efficiency_shock_reversal_10d", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_2_20300530_relative_downside_reversal_10d", 0.10, 1),
    ("miner_2_20300124_lowvolatility_10d", 0.08, 1),
]
last_decision = -10**9

def percentile(values):
    finite = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}
    n = len(finite)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(finite):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / max(n, 1)
    return out

def bounded_weights(score):
    # Diversified full investment; defensive posture is expressed through assets.
    lo, hi = 0.02, 0.15
    raw = {s: max(float(score.get(s, 0.5)), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE}
    w = {s: raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in UNIVERSE}
    for _ in range(40):
        fixed = {s: (lo if w[s] < lo else hi) for s in UNIVERSE if w[s] < lo or w[s] > hi}
        if not fixed: break
        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]
        rem = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())
        z = sum(raw[s] for s in free)
        w = dict(fixed)
        for s in free: w[s] = rem * raw[s] / max(z, 1e-12)
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: float(w[s] / z) for s in UNIVERSE}

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global last_decision
    closes = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 130: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        if len(c) >= 130 and np.all(np.isfinite(c)) and np.all(c > 0): closes[s] = c
    if len(closes) < 10: return
    end = min(len(c) for c in closes.values()) - 2  # only completed data, with one-day lag
    if end < 100 or end - last_decision < 10: return
    vals = {fid: {} for fid, _, _ in ENSEMBLE}
    # Price-only implementations of the admitted, close-based factor definitions.
    for s, c in closes.items():
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        r10, r20 = r[end-10:end], r[end-20:end]
        v10, v20 = max(np.std(r10), .008), max(np.std(r20), .008)
        hist = [np.std(r[k-20:k]) for k in range(max(20, end-80), end)]
        baseline = max(float(np.median(hist)), .008)
        ret10 = c[end] / c[end-10] - 1.0
        path = max(float(np.sum(np.abs(r10))), 1e-8)
        d = r20[r20 < 0]
        dvol = max(float(np.std(d)) if len(d) > 1 else v20, .008)
        downshare = float(np.mean(r20 < 0))
        # Compression and defensive-quality favor stable, orderly assets.
        vals[ENSEMBLE[0][0]][s] = -(v20 / baseline) - .25 * max(v10 / v20 - 1, 0)
        vals[ENSEMBLE[1][0]][s] = -v20 - .25 * max(v20 - baseline, 0)
        vals[ENSEMBLE[2][0]][s] = (-ret10 / dvol) if c[end] / c[end-60] - 1 > -.15 else 0.0
        efficiency = abs(ret10) / path
        vals[ENSEMBLE[3][0]][s] = -ret10 / v20 * (1 - min(efficiency, 1))
        med10 = np.median([closes[x][end] / closes[x][end-10] - 1 for x in closes])
        vals[ENSEMBLE[4][0]][s] = -(ret10 - med10) / dvol
        vals[ENSEMBLE[5][0]][s] = -v20
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for fid, wt, direction in ENSEMBLE:
        rr = percentile(vals[fid])
        for s in UNIVERSE: score[s] += wt * direction * rr[s]
    # Bullish but medium risk: retain breadth, with a modest defensive tilt.
    breadth = np.mean([closes[s][end] > closes[s][end-60] for s in closes])
    if breadth < .55:
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"): score[s] += .10
    score = {s: score[s] - min(score.values()) + .05 for s in UNIVERSE}
    target = bounded_weights(score)
    avg, sd = np.mean(list(score.values())), max(np.std(list(score.values())), 1e-8)
    forecast = {s: float(.006 * (score[s] - avg) / sd) for s in UNIVERSE}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=[x[0] for x in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    last_decision = end
"}

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"file_path":"strategy.py","content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nENSEMBLE = [\\n    (\\"miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d\\", .25, 1),\\n    (\\"miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1\\", .18, 1),\\n    (\\"relative_lowvolatility_10d\\", .13, 1),\\n    (\\"miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d\\", .18, 1),\\n    (\\"relative_residual_reversal_10d\\", .08, 1),\\n    (\\"miner_1_range_efficiency_reversal_10d_v2\\", .08, 1),\\n    (\\"miner_1_volscaled_momentum20_10d\\", .05, 1),\\n    (\\"miner_1_residual_momentum_quality_10d\\", .05, 1),\\n]\\nlast_decision = -10**9\\n\\ndef ranks(x):\\n    good = sorted(v for v in x.values() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {s: .5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    if len(good) > 1:\\n        for s, v in x.items():\\n            if np.isfinite(v): out[s] = np.searchsorted(good, v, side=\\"right\\") / len(good)\\n    return out\\n\\ndef bounded(raw):\\n    w = {s: max(float(raw[s]), 1e-8) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    for _ in range(30):\\n        z = sum(w.values()); w = {s: v / z for s, v in w.items()}\\n        lo = [s for s in UNIVERSE if w[s] < .02]\\n        hi = [s for s in UNIVERSE if w[s] > .15]\\n        if not lo and not hi: break\\n        fixed = {s: .02 for s in lo}; fixed.update({s: .15 for s in hi})\\n        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]\\n        rem = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values()); den = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        w = dict(fixed)\\n        for s in free: w[s] = rem * w[s] / max(den, 1e-12)\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / z for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef strategy():\\n    global last_decision\\n    closes = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=340)\\n        if df is not None and len(df) >= 270:\\n            c = np.asarray(df.sort_values(\\"date\\")[\\"close\\"], float)\\n            if np.all(np.isfinite(c)) and np.all(c > 0): closes[s] = c\\n    if len(closes) < 10: return\\n    end = min(len(c) for c in closes.values()) - 2\\n    if end < 260 or end - last_decision < 10: return\\n    ret = {s: np.diff(np.log(c)) for s, c in closes.items()}\\n    r10 = {s: ret[s][end-10:end].sum() for s in closes}\\n    r20 = {s: ret[s][end-20:end].sum() for s in closes}\\n    vol10 = {s: max(np.std(ret[s][end-10:end]), .008) for s in closes}\\n    vol20 = {s: max(np.std(ret[s][end-20:end]), .008) for s in closes}\\n    medvol = max(float(np.median(list(vol20.values()))), .008)\\n    med20 = float(np.median(list(r20.values())))\\n    vals = {f: {} for f, _, _ in ENSEMBLE}\\n    for s in closes:\\n        prior = max(np.std(ret[s][end-30:end-10]), .008)\\n        longv = max(np.std(ret[s][end-40:end]), .008)\\n        hist = [np.std(ret[s][j-20:j]) for j in range(max(20, end-120), end)]\\n        hmed = max(float(np.median(hist)), .008)\\n        abs10 = max(np.sum(np.abs(ret[s][end-10:end])), .008)\\n        abs20 = max(np.sum(np.abs(ret[s][end-20:end])), .008)\\n        vals[\\"miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d\\"][s] = -(vol20[s]/hmed) - .5*(vol20[s]/prior-1)\\n        vals[\\"miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1\\"][s] = -(vol10[s]/longv-1)\\n        vals[\\"relative_lowvolatility_10d\\"][s] = -np.log(vol20[s]/medvol)\\n        # Contrarian residual proxies are cross-sectional residual ranks.\\n        vals[\\"miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d\\"][s] = -(r20[s]-med20)/vol20[s]\\n        vals[\\"relative_residual_reversal_10d\\"][s] = -(r10[s]-float(np.median(list(r10.values()))))/vol10[s]\\n        vals[\\"miner_1_range_efficiency_reversal_10d_v2\\"][s] = -(abs10-abs(r10[s]))/abs10\\n        vals[\\"miner_1_volscaled_momentum20_10d\\"][s] = r20[s]/max(abs20, .008)\\n        vals[\\"miner_1_residual_momentum_quality_10d\\"][s] = r10[s]/vol10[s]\\n    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    for f, wt, direction in ENSEMBLE:\\n        rr = ranks(vals[f])\\n        for s in UNIVERSE: score[s] += wt * direction * rr[s]\\n    breadth = np.mean([ret[s][end-60:end].sum() > 0 for s in closes])\\n    if breadth < .45:\\n        for s in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"): score[s] += .10\\n    floor = min(score.values())\\n    target = bounded({s: score[s]-floor+.05 for s in UNIVERSE})\\n    avg = np.mean(list(score.values())); sd = max(np.std(list(score.values())), 1e-8)\\n    forecast = {s: float(.006*(score[s]-avg)/sd) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast,\\n                         factor_ids=[f for f, _, _ in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)\\n    last_decision = end\\n"}', call_id='call_DAVOgZZNES0evuO1A3XqnjH5', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_tmp_ewintggtg95', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

- Reassess factor weights if volatility rises, breadth deteriorates, or reversal factors again show persistent negative recent-window performance.

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
ENSEMBLE = [
 ("miner_3_20290823_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", .18, 1),
 ("miner_1_20300307_volatility_compression_10d", .15, 1),
 ("miner_3_20300711_relative_lowvolatility_10d", .12, 1),
 ("miner_1_20281005_volatility_scaled_reversal_1d", .12, 1),
 ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", .12, 1),
 ("miner_3_20300613_relative_residual_reversal_10d", .11, 1),
 ("miner_3_20300725_trend_inefficiency_reversal_10d", .10, 1),
 ("miner_2_20311225_continuous_vix_residual_reversal_5d", .05, 1),
 ("miner_2_20301003_risk_adjusted_breadth_momentum_10d", .05, 1)]
_day = 0

def ranks(d):
    a = np.array(list(d.values()), float)
    good = a[np.isfinite(a)]
    return {s: (float(np.mean(good <= v)) if np.isfinite(v) else .5) for s,v in d.items()}

def vol(x, n):
    return max(float(np.std(x[-n:])), 1e-5)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    px = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is not None and len(df) >= 140:
            c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
            if len(c) >= 140 and np.all(np.isfinite(c)) and np.all(c > 0): px[s] = c
    if len(px) < 10:
        return
    n = min(len(v) for v in px.values())
    r = {s: np.diff(np.log(v[-n:])) for s,v in px.items()}
    market = np.mean(np.array(list(r.values())), axis=0)
    mvar = max(float(np.var(market[-60:])), 1e-8)
    m5, m10, m20 = sum(market[-5:]), sum(market[-10:]), sum(market[-20:])
    medv = max(float(np.median([vol(x,20) for x in r.values()])), 1e-5)
    sig = {f:{} for f,_,_ in ENSEMBLE}
    for s,x in r.items():
        v1,v5,v10,v20 = vol(x,1),vol(x,5),vol(x,10),vol(x,20)
        old = vol(x[:-20],20)
        beta = float(np.cov(x[-60:],market[-60:])[0,1] / mvar)
        res5 = sum(x[-5:]) - beta*m5
        res10 = sum(x[-10:]) - beta*m10
        res20 = sum(x[-20:]) - beta*m20
        path = max(float(np.abs(x[-10:]).sum()), .01)
        downside = float(np.mean(np.minimum(x[-20:],0)))
        # Proxies preserve the ensemble's directions and horizons.
        sig[ENSEMBLE[0][0]][s] = -v20/max(old,1e-5) - .3*v20/vol(x[:-10],20)
        sig[ENSEMBLE[1][0]][s] = -np.log(v10/max(old,1e-5))
        sig[ENSEMBLE[2][0]][s] = -np.log(v20/medv)
        sig[ENSEMBLE[3][0]][s] = -res5/max(v5,1e-5)
        sig[ENSEMBLE[4][0]][s] = -res20/max(v20,1e-5)
        sig[ENSEMBLE[5][0]][s] = -res10/max(v10,1e-5)
        sig[ENSEMBLE[6][0]][s] = -(sum(x[-10:])/path)/max(v10,1e-5)
        sig[ENSEMBLE[7][0]][s] = -res5/max(v5,1e-5)
        sig[ENSEMBLE[8][0]][s] = (.6*sum(x[-20:])+.4*sum(x[-10:]))/max(v20,1e-5)
    score = {s:0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for f,w,d in ENSEMBLE:
        q = ranks(sig[f])
        for s in UNIVERSE: score[s] += w*d*(q.get(s,.5)-.5)
    # High-risk regime: defensive tradable tilt, while keeping full investment.
    breadth = np.mean([sum(x[-20:]) > 0 for x in r.values()])
    vix_scale = 1.0
    vf = get_index_daily_data(symbol="VIX", days=30)
    if vf is not None and len(vf) >= 6:
        vc = np.asarray(vf.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
        vix_scale = float(np.clip(vc[-1]/max(np.median(vc[-21:]),1e-6),.5,2.5))
    if breadth < .55 or vix_scale > 1.10:
        for s,b in (("XAU",.08),("US10Y",.055),("CN10Y",.045)): score[s] += b
    z = np.array([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE], float)
    z = np.clip((z-z.mean())/max(z.std(),1e-8),-1.8,1.8)
    e = np.exp(.55*z); e /= e.sum()
    target = {s: float(.70*e[i] + .30/15) for i,s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    forecast = {s: float(.004*z[i]) for i,s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=[f for f,_,_ in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact Screener ensemble for 2032-02-19; all directions are +1.
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.18, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.15, 1),
    ("miner_2_20300124_lowvolatility_10d", 0.14, 1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", 0.14, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", 0.12, 1),
    ("relative_residual_reversal_10d", 0.10, 1),
    ("volatility_scaled_reversal_1d", 0.07, 1),
    ("trend_inefficiency_reversal_10d", 0.05, 1),

        raw[7][s] = -(float(np.sum(x[-10:])) / path) / v10

        drawdown = max(0.0, -float(np.sum(x[-20:])))
        raw[8][s] = (-res5 / v5) * (1.0 + min(drawdown, 0.20))

    for k, (_, w, direction) in enumerate(ENSEMBLE):

    if breadth < 0.55 or vix_ratio > 1.10:

    z = np.asarray([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE], float)

    e = np.exp(0.55 * z)

    target = {s: float(0.70 * e[i] + 0.30 / len(UNIVERSE)) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    forecast = {s: float(0.004 * z[i]) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast,
                         factor_ids=[f for f, _, _ in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0

### Strategy Configuration
- **Universe:** All 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
- **Factors:** Exact 8-factor Screener ensemble, with synchronized weights and positive directions.
- **Allocation:** 70% rank-softmax composite plus 30% equal-weight diversification floor.
- **Rebalancing:** Every 10 trading days.
- **Position sizing:** Fully invested, long-only, fractional quantities.
- **Forecast horizon:** Deterministic 10-day forecasts for all 15 assets.

### Risk Adjustment
- Applied a defensive tilt toward **XAU, US10Y, and CN10Y** under elevated volatility or weak breadth.
- Kept reversal factors capped at 24% of the ensemble.
- Maintained full investment with no cash sleeve.

### Validation Outcomes
120-trading-day backtest through 2032-03-17:

- Backtest performance improved modestly versus the prior configuration, but live performance deteriorated sharply.
- The bearish correction persisted, reducing the effectiveness of positive reversal exposure.
- Defensive allocation and full-investment constraints were correctly maintained.

### Feedback to Screener
- Reversal and momentum factors appear vulnerable in the continuing bearish regime.
- Maintain conservative reversal exposure until breadth and trend conditions improve.
- Monitor crowding among the four defensive/low-volatility factors.
- Stronger compression or explicitly downside-risk-controlled factors would be preferable for the next cycle.

### Plans
- Retain the 10-day cadence and 70/30 composite-diversification structure.
- Keep defensive asset tilts active under high volatility.
- Avoid increasing reversal exposure.
- Reassess whether momentum should be reduced further if the next ensemble remains bearish.

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.25, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", 0.18, 1),
    ("miner_2_20300124_lowvolatility_10d", 0.15, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", 0.10, 1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_3_tailrisk_reversal_10d", 0.08, 1),
]
_day = 0

def rank_cs(vals):
    good = [v for v in vals.values() if np.isfinite(v)]
    if not good: return {s: 0.5 for s in vals}
    return {s: (float(np.mean(np.asarray(good) <= v)) if np.isfinite(v) else 0.5) for s, v in vals.items()}

def vol(x, n): return max(float(np.std(x[-n:])), 1e-5)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10: return
    px = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is not None and len(df) >= 140:
            x = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(x)) and np.all(x > 0): px[s] = x
    if len(px) < 10: return
    n = min(map(len, px.values()))
    r = {s: np.diff(np.log(x[-n:])) for s, x in px.items()}
    m = np.mean(np.asarray(list(r.values())), axis=0)
    mv = max(float(np.var(m[-60:])), 1e-8)
    m10, m20 = float(np.sum(m[-10:])), float(np.sum(m[-20:]))
    medv = max(float(np.median([vol(x, 20) for x in r.values()])), 1e-5)
    raw = [{s: np.nan for s in UNIVERSE} for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, x in r.items():
        v10, v20 = vol(x, 10), vol(x, 20)
        p20, p10 = vol(x[:-20], 20), vol(x[:-10], 20)
        beta = float(np.cov(x[-60:], m[-60:])[0, 1] / mv)
        res10, res20 = np.sum(x[-10:]) - beta*m10, np.sum(x[-20:]) - beta*m20
        path = max(float(np.abs(x[-10:]).sum()), .01)
        raw[0][s] = -v20/p20 - .30*v20/p10
        raw[1][s] = -np.log(v10/p20)
        raw[2][s] = -np.log(v20/medv)
        raw[3][s] = -np.log(v10/max(v20, 1e-5))
        raw[4][s] = np.sum(x[-20:])/max(v20, 1e-5)
        raw[5][s] = -res20/v20
        raw[6][s] = -(np.sum(x[-10:])/path)/v10
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (_, w, d) in enumerate(ENSEMBLE):
        q = rank_cs(raw[i])
        for s in UNIVERSE: score[s] += w*d*(q[s]-.5)
    breadth = float(np.mean([np.sum(x[-20:]) > 0 for x in r.values()]))
    vr = 1.0
    vix = get_index_daily_data(symbol="VIX", days=30)
    if vix is not None and len(vix) >= 6:
        vc = np.asarray(vix.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        vr = float(np.clip(vc[-1]/max(np.median(vc[-21:]), 1e-6), .5, 2.5))
    if breadth < .55 or vr > 1.10:
        for s, b in (("XAU", .08), ("US10Y", .055), ("CN10Y", .045)): score[s] += b
    z = np.asarray([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE], dtype=float)
    z = np.clip((z-z.mean())/max(z.std(), 1e-8), -1.8, 1.8)
    e = np.exp(.55*z); e /= e.sum()
    target = {s: float(.70*e[i] + .30/15) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    forecast = {s: float(.004*z[i]) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=[x[0] for x in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.25, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", 0.18, 1),
    ("miner_2_20300124_lowvolatility_10d", 0.15, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", 0.10, 1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_3_tailrisk_reversal_10d", 0.08, 1),
]
_day = 0

def rank_cs(vals):
    good = [v for v in vals.values() if np.isfinite(v)]
    if not good: return {s: 0.5 for s in vals}
    return {s: (float(np.mean(np.asarray(good) <= v)) if np.isfinite(v) else 0.5) for s, v in vals.items()}

def vol(x, n): return max(float(np.std(x[-n:])), 1e-5)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10: return
    px = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is not None and len(df) >= 140:
            x = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(x)) and np.all(x > 0): px[s] = x
    if len(px) < 10: return
    n = min(map(len, px.values()))
    r = {s: np.diff(np.log(x[-n:])) for s, x in px.items()}
    m = np.mean(np.asarray(list(r.values())), axis=0)
    mv = max(float(np.var(m[-60:])), 1e-8)
    m10, m20 = float(np.sum(m[-10:])), float(np.sum(m[-20:]))
    medv = max(float(np.median([vol(x, 20) for x in r.values()])), 1e-5)
    raw = [{s: np.nan for s in UNIVERSE} for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, x in r.items():
        v10, v20 = vol(x, 10), vol(x, 20)
        p20, p10 = vol(x[:-20], 20), vol(x[:-10], 20)
        beta = float(np.cov(x[-60:], m[-60:])[0, 1] / mv)
        res10, res20 = np.sum(x[-10:]) - beta*m10, np.sum(x[-20:]) - beta*m20
        path = max(float(np.abs(x[-10:]).sum()), .01)
        raw[0][s] = -v20/p20 - .30*v20/p10
        raw[1][s] = -np.log(v10/p20)
        raw[2][s] = -np.log(v20/medv)
        raw[3][s] = -np.log(v10/max(v20, 1e-5))
        raw[4][s] = np.sum(x[-20:])/max(v20, 1e-5)
        raw[5][s] = -res20/v20
        raw[6][s] = -(np.sum(x[-10:])/path)/v10
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (_, w, d) in enumerate(ENSEMBLE):
        q = rank_cs(raw[i])
        for s in UNIVERSE: score[s] += w*d*(q[s]-.5)
    breadth = float(np.mean([np.sum(x[-20:]) > 0 for x in r.values()]))
    vr = 1.0
    vix = get_index_daily_data(symbol="VIX", days=30)
    if vix is not None and len(vix) >= 6:
        vc = np.asarray(vix.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        vr = float(np.clip(vc[-1]/max(np.median(vc[-21:]), 1e-6), .5, 2.5))
    if breadth < .55 or vr > 1.10:
        for s, b in (("XAU", .08), ("US10Y", .055), ("CN10Y", .045)): score[s] += b
    z = np.asarray([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE], dtype=float)
    z = np.clip((z-z.mean())/max(z.std(), 1e-8), -1.8, 1.8)
    e = np.exp(.55*z); e /= e.sum()
    target = {s: float(.70*e[i] + .30/15) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    forecast = {s: float(.004*z[i]) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=[x[0] for x in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("trend_quality_contrarian_10d", 0.28, -1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", 0.18, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.17, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.13, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", 0.11, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", 0.08, 1),
    ("miner_1_20320513_breadth_conditioned_relative_reversal_10d", 0.05, 1),
]
_day = 0

def rank_cs(vals):
    good = [v for v in vals.values() if np.isfinite(v)]
    return {s: (float(np.mean(np.asarray(good) <= v)) if np.isfinite(v) else .5) for s, v in vals.items()}

def vol(r, n):
    return max(float(np.std(r[-n:])), 1e-6)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    prices = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is not None and len(df) >= 150:
            x = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(x)) and np.all(x > 0): prices[s] = x
    if len(prices) < 10: return
    n = min(len(x) for x in prices.values())
    rets = {s: np.diff(np.log(x[-n:])) for s, x in prices.items()}
    market = np.mean(np.asarray(list(rets.values())), axis=0)
    mvar = max(float(np.var(market[-60:])), 1e-8)
    market20 = float(np.sum(market[-20:]))
    medvol = max(float(np.median([vol(r, 20) for r in rets.values()])), 1e-6)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact Screener ensemble: factor_id, weight, direction.
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("trend_quality_contrarian_10d", .24, -1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", .19, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", .20, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", .14, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", .10, 1),
    ("miner_1_20320401_unstable_trend_reversal_10d", .10, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", .03, 1),
]
_day = 0

def cs_rank(x):
    a = [v for v in x.values() if np.isfinite(v)]
    if not a: return {s: .5 for s in x}
    return {s: (float(np.mean(np.asarray(a) <= v)) if np.isfinite(v) else .5) for s, v in x.items()}

def sd(r, n):
    return max(float(np.std(r[-n:])), 1e-6)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    px = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150: continue
        q = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        if len(q) >= 150 and np.all(np.isfinite(q)) and np.all(q > 0):
            px[s] = q
    if len(px) < 10:
        _day = 0
        return
    n = min(len(q) for q in px.values())
    ret = {s: np.diff(np.log(q[-n:])) for s, q in px.items()}
    market = np.mean(np.asarray(list(ret.values())), axis=0)
    market_var = max(float(np.var(market[-60:])), 1e-8)
    m20 = float(np.sum(market[-20:]))
    medvol = max(float(np.median([sd(r, 20) for r in ret.values()])), 1e-6)
    raw = [{s: np.nan for s in UNIVERSE} for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, r in ret.items():
        v10, v20 = sd(r, 10), sd(r, 20)
        old20 = sd(r[:-20], 20); old40 = sd(r[:-40], 20)
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], market[-60:])[0, 1] / market_var)
        net10, net20, net40 = np.sum(r[-10:]), np.sum(r[-20:]), np.sum(r[-40:])
        # Quality trend, then reversed by the persisted -1 direction.
        raw[0][s] = (net40 / sd(r, 40)) * abs(net40) / max(np.abs(r[-40:]).sum(), .01)
        # Residual reversal, compression, continuation, and low volatility.
        raw[1][s] = -(net20 - beta * m20) / v20
        raw[2][s] = -np.log(v10 / max(old20, 1e-6))
        raw[3][s] = net20 / v20
        raw[4][s] = -v20 / medvol
        # Unstable-trend reversal: penalize recent trend when volatility expands.
        raw[5][s] = -net10 / (v10 * np.sqrt(10)) - .25 * net20 / v20
        # Defensive volatility quality: low vol with shallow recent loss.
        raw[6][s] = -v20 / medvol - .25 * min(net20, 0.0) / v20
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (_, w, direction) in enumerate(ENSEMBLE):
        rr = cs_rank(raw[i])
        for s in UNIVERSE:
            score[s] += w * direction * (rr[s] - .5)
    # In a high-risk rebound, use only a modest defensive tilt; remain fully invested.
    breadth = np.mean([np.sum(r[-20:]) > 0 for r in ret.values()])
    vix = get_index_daily_data(symbol="VIX", days=30)
    vix_ratio = 1.0
    if vix is not None and len(vix) >= 6:
        vc = np.asarray(vix.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        vix_ratio = float(np.clip(vc[-1] / max(np.median(vc[-21:]), 1e-6), .5, 2.5))
    if breadth < .55 or vix_ratio > 1.10:
        score["XAU"] += .045; score["US10Y"] += .030; score["CN10Y"] += .025
    z = np.asarray([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE])
    z = np.clip((z - z.mean()) / max(z.std(), 1e-8), -1.8, 1.8)
    e = np.exp(.55 * z); e /= e.sum()
    target = {s: float(.70 * e[i] + .30 / len(UNIVERSE)) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    forecast = {s: float(.004 * z[i]) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast,
                         factor_ids=[f[0] for f in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact Screener ensemble: factor_id, weight, direction.
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("trend_quality_contrarian_10d", .24, -1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", .19, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", .20, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", .14, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", .10, 1),
    ("miner_1_20320401_unstable_trend_reversal_10d", .10, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", .03, 1),
]
_day = 0

def cs_rank(x):
    a = [v for v in x.values() if np.isfinite(v)]
    if not a: return {s: .5 for s in x}
    return {s: (float(np.mean(np.asarray(a) <= v)) if np.isfinite(v) else .5) for s, v in x.items()}

def sd(r, n):
    return max(float(np.std(r[-n:])), 1e-6)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    px = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150: continue
        q = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        if len(q) >= 150 and np.all(np.isfinite(q)) and np.all(q > 0):
            px[s] = q
    if len(px) < 10:
        _day = 0
        return
    n = min(len(q) for q in px.values())
    ret = {s: np.diff(np.log(q[-n:])) for s, q in px.items()}
    market = np.mean(np.asarray(list(ret.values())), axis=0)
    market_var = max(float(np.var(market[-60:])), 1e-8)
    m20 = float(np.sum(market[-20:]))
    medvol = max(float(np.median([sd(r, 20) for r in ret.values()])), 1e-6)
    raw = [{s: np.nan for s in UNIVERSE} for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, r in ret.items():
        v10, v20 = sd(r, 10), sd(r, 20)
        old20 = sd(r[:-20], 20); old40 = sd(r[:-40], 20)
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], market[-60:])[0, 1] / market_var)
        net10, net20, net40 = np.sum(r[-10:]), np.sum(r[-20:]), np.sum(r[-40:])
        # Quality trend, then reversed by the persisted -1 direction.
        raw[0][s] = (net40 / sd(r, 40)) * abs(net40) / max(np.abs(r[-40:]).sum(), .01)
        # Residual reversal, compression, continuation, and low volatility.

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact active Screener ensemble (six factors; directions are preserved).
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("trend_quality_contrarian_10d", 0.24, -1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", 0.19, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.18, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", 0.14, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.14, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", 0.11, 1),
]
_day = 0

def rank(values):
    finite = [v for v in values.values() if np.isfinite(v)]
    if not finite:
        return {s: 0.5 for s in values}
    return {s: (float(np.mean(np.asarray(finite) <= v)) if np.isfinite(v) else 0.5)
            for s, v in values.items()}

def vol(r, n):
    return max(float(np.std(r[-n:])), 1e-6)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    series = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        if np.all(np.isfinite(close)) and np.all(close > 0):
            series[s] = close
    if len(series) < 10:
        _day = 0
        return
    n = min(len(x) for x in series.values())
    returns = {s: np.diff(np.log(x[-n:])) for s, x in series.items()}
    market = np.mean(np.asarray(list(returns.values())), axis=0)
    market_var = max(float(np.var(market[-60:])), 1e-8)
    market20 = float(np.sum(market[-20:]))
    median_vol = max(float(np.median([vol(r, 20) for r in returns.values()])), 1e-6)
    signals = [{s: np.nan for s in UNIVERSE} for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, r in returns.items():
        v10, v20, v40 = vol(r, 10), vol(r, 20), vol(r, 40)
        prior20 = vol(r[:-20], 20)
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], market[-60:])[0, 1] / market_var)
        net10, net20, net40 = np.sum(r[-10:]), np.sum(r[-20:]), np.sum(r[-40:])
        # Contrarian quality: direction -1 reverses this trend-quality rank.
        signals[0][s] = (net40 / v40) * abs(net40) / max(np.abs(r[-40:]).sum(), .01)
        # Residual reversal factor as persisted: positive residual reversal score.
        signals[1][s] = -(net20 - beta * market20) / v20
        # Compression, vol-scaled momentum, defensive quality, and low volatility.
        signals[2][s] = -np.log(v10 / prior20)
        signals[3][s] = net20 / v20
        signals[4][s] = -v20 / median_vol - 0.25 * min(net20, 0.0) / v20
        signals[5][s] = -v20 / median_vol
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (_, weight, direction) in enumerate(ENSEMBLE):
        ranks = rank(signals[i])
        for s in UNIVERSE:
            score[s] += weight * direction * (ranks[s] - 0.5)
    # Bullish but unstable: retain full investment and add only a small defensive tilt.
    breadth = float(np.mean([np.sum(r[-20:]) > 0 for r in returns.values()]))
    vix = get_index_daily_data(symbol="VIX", days=30)
    vix_ratio = 1.0
    if vix is not None and len(vix) >= 6:
        vc = np.asarray(vix.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        vix_ratio = float(np.clip(vc[-1] / max(np.median(vc[-21:]), 1e-6), 0.5, 2.5))
    if breadth < 0.55 or vix_ratio > 1.10:
        score["XAU"] += 0.045
        score["US10Y"] += 0.030
        score["CN10Y"] += 0.025
    z = np.asarray([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE], dtype=float)
    z = np.clip((z - z.mean()) / max(z.std(), 1e-8), -1.8, 1.8)
    exp_score = np.exp(0.55 * z)
    exp_score /= exp_score.sum()
    target = {s: float(0.70 * exp_score[i] + 0.30 / len(UNIVERSE)) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    forecast = {s: float(0.004 * z[i]) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast,
                         factor_ids=[f[0] for f in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact Screener ensemble: factor_id, weight, direction.
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("trend_quality_contrarian_10d", .24, -1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", .19, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", .20, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", .14, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", .10, 1),
    ("miner_1_20320401_unstable_trend_reversal_10d", .10, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", .03, 1),
]
_day = 0

def cs_rank(x):
    a = [v for v in x.values() if np.isfinite(v)]
    if not a: return {s: .5 for s in x}
    return {s: (float(np.mean(np.asarray(a) <= v)) if np.isfinite(v) else .5) for s, v in x.items()}

def sd(r, n):
    return max(float(np.std(r[-n:])), 1e-6)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    px = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=300)
        if df is None or len(df) < 150: continue
        q = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        if len(q) >= 150 and np.all(np.isfinite(q)) and np.all(q > 0):
            px[s] = q
    if len(px) < 10:
        _day = 0
        return
    n = min(len(q) for q in px.values())
    ret = {s: np.diff(np.log(q[-n:])) for s, q in px.items()}
    market = np.mean(np.asarray(list(ret.values())), axis=0)
    market_var = max(float(np.var(market[-60:])), 1e-8)
    m20 = float(np.sum(market[-20:]))
    medvol = max(float(np.median([sd(r, 20) for r in ret.values()])), 1e-6)
    raw = [{s: np.nan for s in UNIVERSE} for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, r in ret.items():
        v10, v20 = sd(r, 10), sd(r, 20)
        old20 = sd(r[:-20], 20); old40 = sd(r[:-40], 20)
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], market[-60:])[0, 1] / market_var)
        net10, net20, net40 = np.sum(r[-10:]), np.sum(r[-20:]), np.sum(r[-40:])
        # Quality trend, then reversed by the persisted -1 direction.
        raw[0][s] = (net40 / sd(r, 40)) * abs(net40) / max(np.abs(r[-40:]).sum(), .01)
        # Residual reversal, compression, continuation, and low volatility.
        raw[1][s] = -(net20 - beta * m20) / v20
        raw[2][s] = -np.log(v10 / max(old20, 1e-6))
        raw[3][s] = net20 / v20
        raw[4][s] = -v20 / medvol
        # Unstable-trend reversal: penalize recent trend when volatility expands.
        raw[5][s] = -net10 / (v10 * np.sqrt(10)) - .25 * net20 / v20
        # Defensive volatility quality: low vol with shallow recent loss.
        raw[6][s] = -v20 / medvol - .25 * min(net20, 0.0) / v20
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (_, w, direction) in enumerate(ENSEMBLE):
        rr = cs_rank(raw[i])
        for s in UNIVERSE:
            score[s] += w * direction * (rr[s] - .5)
    # In a high-risk rebound, use only a modest defensive tilt; remain fully invested.
    breadth = np.mean([np.sum(r[-20:]) > 0 for r in ret.values()])
    vix = get_index_daily_data(symbol="VIX", days=30)
    vix_ratio = 1.0
    if vix is not None and len(vix) >= 6:
        vc = np.asarray(vix.sort_values("date")["close"], dtype=float)
        vix_ratio = float(np.clip(vc[-1] / max(np.median(vc[-21:]), 1e-6), .5, 2.5))
    if breadth < .55 or vix_ratio > 1.10:
        score["XAU"] += .045; score["US10Y"] += .030; score["CN10Y"] += .025
    z = np.asarray([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE])
    z = np.clip((z - z.mean()) / max(z.std(), 1e-8), -1.8, 1.8)
    e = np.exp(.55 * z); e /= e.sum()
    target = {s: float(.70 * e[i] + .30 / len(UNIVERSE)) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    forecast = {s: float(.004 * z[i]) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast,
                         factor_ids=[f[0] for f in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import (register_hook, get_stock_daily_data,
    get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights)

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("trend_quality_contrarian_10d", 0.18, -1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", 0.16, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.18, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", 0.13, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.10, 1),
    ("miner_1_20320401_unstable_trend_reversal_10d", 0.08, 1),
    ("miner_3_20320805_smoothed_downside_residual_reversal_20d", 0.03, 1),
    ("volume_confirmed_reversal_20d", 0.02, 1),
]
_day = 0

def ranks(x):
    a = np.asarray([x.get(s, np.nan) for s in UNIVERSE], float)
    good = a[np.isfinite(a)]
    mid = float(np.median(good)) if len(good) else 0.0
    a[~np.isfinite(a)] = mid
    order = np.argsort(np.argsort(a))
    return {s: float(order[i] / max(len(a)-1, 1) - .5) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}

def vol(r, n):
    return max(float(np.std(r[-n:])), 1e-6)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    px = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=340)
        if df is None or len(df) < 160:
            continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
        if np.all(np.isfinite(c)) and np.all(c > 0): px[s] = c
    if len(px) < 10:
        _day = 0
        return
    n = min(map(len, px.values()))

    raw = [dict() for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, r in ret.items():

        n10, n20, n40 = sum(r[-10:]), sum(r[-20:]), sum(r[-40:])

        raw[3][s] = n20 / v20
        raw[4][s] = -v20 / medv
        raw[5][s] = -v20 / medv - .25 * min(n20, 0.) / v20
        raw[6][s] = -(n10/v10) * abs(n10) / max(np.abs(r[-10:]).sum(), .01)

### Strategy Configuration
- **Universe:** All 15 tradable benchmark assets.
- **Factors:** Exact 9-factor Screener ensemble, with synchronized weights and directions.
- **Weighting:** 70% rank-softmax composite plus 30% equal-weight diversification floor.
- **Position sizing:** Fully invested, long-only, fractional quantities.
- **Rebalancing:** Every 10 trading days.
- **Forecast horizon:** Deterministic 10-day forecasts supplied for all assets.
- **Migration metadata:** All selected factor IDs passed to the rebalance helper.

### Risk Adjustment
- Preserved full investment with no cash sleeve.
- Applied compression, low-volatility, and defensive-volatility tilts.
- Retained limited momentum exposure at 13%.
- Added conditional XAU, US10Y, and CN10Y tilts under weaker breadth or elevated VIX.
- Used lagged, cross-sectional ranking and capped standardized scores to limit concentration.

### Validation Outcomes
120-trading-day backtest through 2032-08-04:

- **Total return:** +1.78%
- **Annualized return:** +3.76%
- **Sharpe ratio:** 0.70
- **Maximum drawdown:** 4.06%
- **Calmar ratio:** 0.93
- **Average gross/net position rate:** 100%

The revised implementation improved historical return and Sharpe relative to the prior configuration, but this remains a limited validation sample.

### Execution Results
Live block from 2032-08-05 to 2032-08-19:

- **Period return:** -1.58%
- **Annualized return:** -31.85%
- **Sharpe ratio:** -14.93
- **Maximum drawdown:** 1.66%

- **Average gross/net position rate:** 100%

### Factor Performance
Individual attribution was unavailable. Compression and low-volatility factors may have reduced participation, while the additional downside-residual and volume-confirmed reversal signals remain too new for reliable live attribution.

### Observations
- Live performance remains materially weaker than backtest performance for a second consecutive block.
- The bullish-but-extended assessment appears to have favored reversal positioning, while realized price action likely retained continuation characteristics.
- Reversal-cluster concentration and possible implementation mismatch remain key risks.
- The short sample is insufficient to conclude that the ensemble has permanently failed, but repeated negative live blocks warrant caution.

### Feedback to Screener
- Reassess aggregate correlation among contrarian, residual-reversal, unstable-trend, downside-residual, and volume-confirmed reversal factors.
- Provide live attribution and regime-conditional results for each factor.
- Test whether momentum should receive greater weight while breadth and trend persistence remain positive.
- Audit whether the defensive factors are actually improving downside protection in this cross-asset universe.

### Plans
- Keep the exact Screener ensemble synchronized for the next cycle unless a new ensemble is provided.
- Avoid further increases in reversal or defensive exposure.
- Consider a more continuation-aware risk overlay if bullish breadth persists.
- Continue monitoring live-versus-backtest divergence and reduce score concentration if underperformance continues.

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import (register_hook, get_stock_daily_data,
    get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights)

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact current Screener ensemble: (factor_id, weight, direction).
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("trend_quality_contrarian_10d", 0.18, -1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", 0.16, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.15, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.14, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", 0.10, 1),
    ("miner_1_20290726_downside_asymmetry_momentum_20d", 0.08, 1),
    ("miner_3_20300530_efficiency_shock_reversal_10d", 0.07, 1),
]
_day = 0

def cross_rank(values):
    a = np.asarray([values.get(s, np.nan) for s in UNIVERSE], float)
    good = a[np.isfinite(a)]
    a[~np.isfinite(a)] = np.median(good) if len(good) else 0.0
    order = np.argsort(np.argsort(a))
    return {s: float(order[i] / max(len(a) - 1, 1) - 0.5) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}

def stdev(x, n):
    return max(float(np.std(x[-n:])), 1e-6)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    prices = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=340)
        if df is None or len(df) < 160:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
        if len(close) and np.all(np.isfinite(close)) and np.all(close > 0):
            prices[symbol] = close
    if len(prices) < 10:
        _day = 0
        return
    n = min(len(x) for x in prices.values())
    returns = {s: np.diff(np.log(x[-n:])) for s, x in prices.items()}
    market = np.mean(np.asarray(list(returns.values())), axis=0)
    market_var = max(float(np.var(market[-60:])), 1e-8)
    market_20 = float(np.sum(market[-20:]))
    median_vol = max(float(np.median([stdev(r, 20) for r in returns.values()])), 1e-6)
    raw = [dict() for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, r in returns.items():
        v10, v20, v40 = stdev(r, 10), stdev(r, 20), stdev(r, 40)
        prior_v20 = stdev(r[:-20], 20)
        n10, n20, n40 = sum(r[-10:]), sum(r[-20:]), sum(r[-40:])
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], market[-60:])[0, 1] / market_var)
        residual20 = n20 - beta * market_20
        # Lagged, rank-based proxies for the selected factor definitions.
        raw[0][s] = (n40 / v40) * abs(n40) / max(np.abs(r[-40:]).sum(), .01)
        raw[1][s] = -residual20 / v20
        raw[2][s] = -np.log(v10 / prior_v20)
        raw[3][s] = -v20 / median_vol - .25 * min(n20, 0.0) / v20
        raw[4][s] = -v20 / median_vol
        raw[5][s] = n20 / v20
        raw[6][s] = n20 / v20 - .5 * min(n20, 0.0) / v20
        raw[7][s] = -(n10 / v10) * abs(n10) / max(np.abs(r[-10:]).sum(), .01)
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (_, weight, direction) in enumerate(ENSEMBLE):
        ranked = cross_rank(raw[i])
        for s in UNIVERSE:
            score[s] += weight * direction * ranked[s]
    breadth = float(np.mean([sum(r[-20:]) > 0 for r in returns.values()]))
    vix = get_index_daily_data(symbol="VIX", days=30)
    vix_ratio = 1.0
    if vix is not None and len(vix) >= 6:
        vc = np.asarray(vix.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
        vix_ratio = float(np.clip(vc[-1] / max(np.median(vc[-21:]), 1e-6), .5, 2.5))
    # Full-investment defensive tilt during weak breadth or a volatility shock.
    if breadth < .55 or vix_ratio > 1.10:
        score["XAU"] += .045
        score["US10Y"] += .030
        score["CN10Y"] += .025
    z = np.asarray([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE], float)
    z = np.clip((z - z.mean()) / max(z.std(), 1e-8), -1.8, 1.8)
    soft = np.exp(.55 * z)
    soft /= soft.sum()
    target = {s: float(.70 * soft[i] + .30 / len(UNIVERSE)) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    # Deterministic 10-day forecast is required by the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(.004 * z[i]) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast,
                         factor_ids=[x[0] for x in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import (register_hook, get_stock_daily_data,
    get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights)

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("trend_quality_contrarian_10d", 0.18, -1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", 0.16, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.18, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", 0.13, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.10, 1),
    ("miner_1_20320401_unstable_trend_reversal_10d", 0.08, 1),
    ("miner_3_20320805_smoothed_downside_residual_reversal_20d", 0.03, 1),
    ("volume_confirmed_reversal_20d", 0.02, 1),
]
_day = 0

def ranks(x):
    a = np.asarray([x.get(s, np.nan) for s in UNIVERSE], float)
    good = a[np.isfinite(a)]
    mid = float(np.median(good)) if len(good) else 0.0
    a[~np.isfinite(a)] = mid
    order = np.argsort(np.argsort(a))
    return {s: float(order[i] / max(len(a)-1, 1) - .5) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}

def vol(r, n):
    return max(float(np.std(r[-n:])), 1e-6)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    px = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=340)
        if df is None or len(df) < 160:
            continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
        if np.all(np.isfinite(c)) and np.all(c > 0): px[s] = c
    if len(px) < 10:
        _day = 0
        return
    n = min(map(len, px.values()))
    ret = {s: np.diff(np.log(c[-n:])) for s, c in px.items()}
    market = np.mean(np.asarray(list(ret.values())), axis=0)
    mv = max(float(np.var(market[-60:])), 1e-8)
    m20 = float(np.sum(market[-20:]))
    medv = max(float(np.median([vol(r, 20) for r in ret.values()])), 1e-6)
    raw = [dict() for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, r in ret.items():
        v10, v20, v40 = vol(r,10), vol(r,20), vol(r,40)
        oldv = vol(r[:-20],20)
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], market[-60:])[0,1] / mv)
        n10, n20, n40 = sum(r[-10:]), sum(r[-20:]), sum(r[-40:])
        # Proxies preserve the selected factor directions using lagged prices only.
        raw[0][s] = (n40/v40) * abs(n40) / max(np.abs(r[-40:]).sum(), .01)
        raw[1][s] = -(n20 - beta*m20) / v20
        raw[2][s] = -np.log(v10 / oldv)
        raw[3][s] = n20 / v20
        raw[4][s] = -v20 / medv
        raw[5][s] = -v20 / medv - .25 * min(n20, 0.) / v20
        raw[6][s] = -(n10/v10) * abs(n10) / max(np.abs(r[-10:]).sum(), .01)
        raw[7][s] = -(n20 - beta*m20) / v20 * np.clip(v20 / max(vol(r,60),1e-6), .5, 2.)
        raw[8][s] = -n20 * (np.mean(np.abs(r[-20:])) / max(np.mean(np.abs(r[-60:])),1e-6))
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (_, w, direction) in enumerate(ENSEMBLE):
        q = ranks(raw[i])
        for s in UNIVERSE: score[s] += w * direction * q[s]
    breadth = np.mean([sum(r[-20:]) > 0 for r in ret.values()])
    vix = get_index_daily_data(symbol="VIX", days=30)
    vr = 1.0
    if vix is not None and len(vix) >= 6:
        vc = np.asarray(vix.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
        vr = float(np.clip(vc[-1] / max(np.median(vc[-21:]),1e-6), .5, 2.5))
    if breadth < .55 or vr > 1.10:
        score["XAU"] += .045; score["US10Y"] += .030; score["CN10Y"] += .025
    z = np.asarray([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE], float)
    z = np.clip((z-z.mean()) / max(z.std(),1e-8), -1.8, 1.8)
    e = np.exp(.55*z); e /= e.sum()
    target = {s: float(.70*e[i] + .30/len(UNIVERSE)) for i,s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    forecast = {s: float(.004*z[i]) for i,s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast,
                         factor_ids=[x[0] for x in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact Screener ensemble for 2032-09-02.
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.20, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", 0.14, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.14, 1),
    ("trend_quality_contrarian_10d", 0.12, -1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", 0.10, 1),
    ("miner_1_residual_momentum_quality_10d", 0.08, 1),
    ("miner_2_20301003_risk_adjusted_breadth_momentum_10d", 0.05, 1),
    ("range_position_reversal_60d", 0.05, 1),
]
_day = 0

def rank_factor(x):
    a = np.array([x.get(s, np.nan) for s in UNIVERSE], float)
    good = a[np.isfinite(a)]
    a[~np.isfinite(a)] = np.median(good) if len(good) else 0.0
    ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(a))
    return {s: float(ranks[i] / 14.0 - 0.5) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}

def vol(r, n):
    return max(float(np.std(r[-n:])), 1e-6)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    prices = {}
    for s in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=340)
        if df is None or len(df) < 160:
            continue
        x = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
        if len(x) >= 160 and np.all(np.isfinite(x)) and np.all(x > 0):
            prices[s] = x
    if len(prices) < 10:
        _day = 0
        return
    n = min(len(x) for x in prices.values())
    rets = {s: np.diff(np.log(x[-n:])) for s, x in prices.items()}
    market = np.mean(np.array(list(rets.values())), axis=0)
    mvar = max(float(np.var(market[-60:])), 1e-8)
    m20, medv = float(np.sum(market[-20:])), max(float(np.median([vol(r,20) for r in rets.values()])),1e-6)
    raw = [dict() for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, r in rets.items():
        v10, v20, v40 = vol(r,10), vol(r,20), vol(r,40)
        prior = vol(r[:-20],20)
        n10, n20, n40, n60 = sum(r[-10:]), sum(r[-20:]), sum(r[-40:]), sum(r[-60:])
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], market[-60:])[0,1] / mvar)
        resid = n20 - beta*m20
        # Lagged, rank-normalized proxies: each row corresponds to ENSEMBLE order.
        raw[0][s] = -v20/medv + 0.25*(n20/v20)
        raw[1][s] = -v20/medv
        raw[2][s] = -np.log(v10/prior)
        raw[3][s] = n10/v10
        raw[4][s] = -resid/v20
        raw[5][s] = n20/v20
        raw[6][s] = n20/v20 - 0.35*max(-n20,0)/v20
        raw[7][s] = (n20/v20) * (0.5 + 0.5*float(np.mean(r[-20:] > 0)))
        raw[8][s] = -(float(x[-1]/x[-61]-1) if False else n60/v40)
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (_, w, direction) in enumerate(ENSEMBLE):
        rr = rank_factor(raw[i])
        for s in UNIVERSE:
            score[s] += w * direction * rr[s]
    breadth = float(np.mean([sum(r[-20:]) > 0 for r in rets.values()]))
    vi = get_index_daily_data(symbol="VIX", days=30)
    shock = False
    if vi is not None and len(vi) >= 6:
        vc = np.asarray(vi.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
        shock = float(vc[-1] / max(np.median(vc[-21:]),1e-6)) > 1.10
    if breadth < .55 or shock:
        score["XAU"] += .05; score["US10Y"] += .03; score["CN10Y"] += .02
    z = np.array([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE], float)
    z = np.clip((z-z.mean())/max(z.std(),1e-8), -1.8, 1.8)
    e = np.exp(.55*z); e /= e.sum()
    target = {s: float(.70*e[i] + .30/15.0) for i,s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    forecast = {s: float(.004*z[i]) for i,s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast, factor_ids=[x[0] for x in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0

{"read_file": "import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import (register_hook, get_stock_daily_data,
    get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights)

UNIVERSE = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Exact current Screener ensemble: (factor_id, weight, direction).
ENSEMBLE = [
    ("trend_quality_contrarian_10d", 0.18, -1),
    ("miner_2_20301114_market_residual_reversal_20d", 0.16, 1),
    ("miner_1_volatility_compression_10d_v1", 0.15, 1),
    ("miner_3_defensive_volatility_quality_10d", 0.14, 1),
    ("relative_lowvolatility_10d", 0.12, 1),
    ("miner_1_consistency_volscaled_momentum20_10d", 0.10, 1),
    ("miner_1_20290726_downside_asymmetry_momentum_20d", 0.08, 1),
    ("miner_3_20300530_efficiency_shock_reversal_10d", 0.07, 1),
]
_day = 0

def cross_rank(values):
    a = np.asarray([values.get(s, np.nan) for s in UNIVERSE], float)
    good = a[np.isfinite(a)]
    a[~np.isfinite(a)] = np.median(good) if len(good) else 0.0
    order = np.argsort(np.argsort(a))
    return {s: float(order[i] / max(len(a) - 1, 1) - 0.5) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}

def stdev(x, n):
    return max(float(np.std(x[-n:])), 1e-6)

@register_hook
def strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if _day < 10:
        return
    prices = {}
    for symbol in UNIVERSE:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=340)
        if df is None or len(df) < 160:
            continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
        if len(close) and np.all(np.isfinite(close)) and np.all(close > 0):
            prices[symbol] = close
    if len(prices) < 10:
        _day = 0
        return
    n = min(len(x) for x in prices.values())
    returns = {s: np.diff(np.log(x[-n:])) for s, x in prices.items()}
    market = np.mean(np.asarray(list(returns.values())), axis=0)
    market_var = max(float(np.var(market[-60:])), 1e-8)
    market_20 = float(np.sum(market[-20:]))
    median_vol = max(float(np.median([stdev(r, 20) for r in returns.values()])), 1e-6)
    raw = [dict() for _ in ENSEMBLE]
    for s, r in returns.items():
        v10, v20, v40 = stdev(r, 10), stdev(r, 20), stdev(r, 40)
        prior_v20 = stdev(r[:-20], 20)
        n10, n20, n40 = sum(r[-10:]), sum(r[-20:]), sum(r[-40:])
        beta = float(np.cov(r[-60:], market[-60:])[0, 1] / market_var)
        residual20 = n20 - beta * market_20
        # Lagged, rank-based proxies for the selected factor definitions.
        raw[0][s] = (n40 / v40) * abs(n40) / max(np.abs(r[-40:]).sum(), .01)
        raw[1][s] = -residual20 / v20
        raw[2][s] = -np.log(v10 / prior_v20)
        raw[3][s] = -v20 / median_vol - .25 * min(n20, 0.0) / v20
        raw[4][s] = -v20 / median_vol
        raw[5][s] = n20 / v20
        raw[6][s] = n20 / v20 - .5 * min(n20, 0.0) / v20
        raw[7][s] = -(n10 / v10) * abs(n10) / max(np.abs(r[-10:]).sum(), .01)
    score = {s: 0.0 for s in UNIVERSE}
    for i, (_, weight, direction) in enumerate(ENSEMBLE):
        ranked = cross_rank(raw[i])
        for s in UNIVERSE:
            score[s] += weight * direction * ranked[s]
    breadth = float(np.mean([sum(r[-20:]) > 0 for r in returns.values()]))
    vix = get_index_daily_data(symbol="VIX", days=30)
    vix_ratio = 1.0
    if vix is not None and len(vix) >= 6:
        vc = np.asarray(vix.sort_values("date")["close"], float)
        vix_ratio = float(np.clip(vc[-1] / max(np.median(vc[-21:]), 1e-6), .5, 2.5))
    # Full-investment defensive tilt during weak breadth or a volatility shock.
    if breadth < .55 or vix_ratio > 1.10:
        score["XAU"] += .045
        score["US10Y"] += .030
        score["CN10Y"] += .025
    z = np.asarray([score[s] for s in UNIVERSE], float)
    z = np.clip((z - z.mean()) / max(z.std(), 1e-8), -1.8, 1.8)
    soft = np.exp(.55 * z)
    soft /= soft.sum()
    target = {s: float(.70 * soft[i] + .30 / len(UNIVERSE)) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    # Deterministic 10-day forecast is required by the migration-cost gate.
    forecast = {s: float(.004 * z[i]) for i, s in enumerate(UNIVERSE)}
    rebalance_to_weights(target, forecast_returns=forecast,
                         factor_ids=[x[0] for x in ENSEMBLE], horizon_days=10)
    _day = 0
"}
